introHtml: Faux leather offers a sophisticated, durable finish for health and wellness items like manicure sets and travel kits. Unlike vinyl or plastic, it resists wear while maintaining a professional look that suits corporate gift programs and safety incentive packages. Choose from several rich colors to match your brand, and add your logo with foil stamping or screen printing for a polished result.
